title: Love Can Surprise You
description: Despite her professional expertise, a relationship columnist discovers love does not come easy when forced to partner with a new writer in the love and romance section.

title: Identical Love
description: After being left at the altar, Dr. Charlotte Hudson signs up to volunteer in a health clinic in a tropical country, but her plans of escaping are thrown off when she comes across her former fiancé's twin brother, Seth.

title: Happily Ever Emma
description: As an actress, Emma always acts like she's in love for work but knows little of what true love is. When Emma realizes she has always loved her good friend Gray, she learns how love works.

title: A Taste of Tuscany
description: Vowing to reinvent herself, health-chef guru, April, goes to Italy to learn how to incorporate the country's notorious rich culture of food in her own recipes.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E12 — The Darling Baby
The Darling family returns to Mayberry to look for a husband for Charlene's newborn daughter. Things get complicated when they choose Opie and refuse to take no for an answer.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E13 — Andy and Helen Have Their Day
Andy and Helen take a day off to go on a picnic, but are constantly interrupted by Barney, Goober and other people.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E15 — Otis Sues the County
Otis slips in the sheriff's office and a crooked lawyer convinces him to sue the county so it will be forced to upgrade the jail. Thinking Andy and Barney will be happy, Otis agrees.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E16 — Barney Fife, Realtor
Barney becomes a part-time real-estate agent and soon has a couple of buyers and sellers lined up, including Andy.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E17 — Goober Takes a Car Apart
Left in charge for just a few days, Goober dismantles a car in Andy's office.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E18 — The Rehabilitation of Otis
Otis rides into town on a cow under the impression that it's a horse.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E19 — The Lucky Letter
Barney believes he is hexed when several accidents occur after he fails to continue a "lucky" chain letter.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E20 — Goober and the Art of Love
Andy and Barney hope they will have some privacy with their girlfriends after Goober finds a girl of his own.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E21 — Barney Runs for Sheriff
Barney runs for sheriff when it seems Andy has found another job.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E22 — If I Had a Quarter-Million
Barney stumbles upon a huge sum of money from a bank robbery. Thinking the thief will return to look for his money, Barney decides to go undercover to find and capture him.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E23 — TV or Not TV
A TV production team comes to Mayberry with a proposal to do a television show about the town's sheriff department. Andy becomes suspicious when the production team starts taking interest in Mayberry's bank.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E24 — Guest in the House
Helen gets jealous when Andy's very attractive cousin Gloria stays with the Taylors for a change of environment after she recently got broken up with.

title: A Royal Christmas Tail
description: A prince swaps a glass slipper for a dog tag in his Christmas search for the woman and her dog who stole his heart during one enchanted holiday encounter.

title: Christmas at Mistletoe Manor
description: When a cooking show influencer travels to a centuries-old English castle to honor a World War II nurse, she finds herself swept up by the castle's holiday magic and the unexpected warmth of its charming proprietor.

title: A Royal Icing Christmas
description: A secret baking contest and an unexpected romance teach a duty-bound princess that love may be life's true crowning achievement.

title: A Wisconsin Christmas Pie
description: A pastry chef returns to Wisconsin when she learns her family's farm is on the brink of being sold to developers. Reconnecting with her high school sweetheart, they discover love may just be the recipe for saving the farm -- and their hearts.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E25 — The Case of the Punch in the Nose
Barney comes across a 19-year-old assault case file between Floyd and Mr. Foley. Determined to officially close the case, he tries to get statements from the parties involved.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E26 — Opie's Newspaper
Opie and his friend Howie make their own newspaper, the Mayberry Sun, but nobody buys it. After Andy and Barney encourage him to print more interesting stories, Opie decides to publish all the gossip from around town.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E27 — Aunt Bee's Invisible Beau
Aunt Bee pretends that she is dating a married man to avoid being a third wheel after Clara convinces her that she is preventing romance from blossoming between Andy and Helen.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E28 — The Arrest of the Fun Girls
When two young women get a speeding ticket, they enjoy the attention from Andy and Barney.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E29 — The Luck of Newton Monroe
A traveling salesman who sells items out of the trunk of his car arrives in Mayberry. However, he is plagued with bad luck and everything he touches turns into a minor disaster.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E30 — Opie Flunks Arithmetic
Barney helps Opie with his schoolwork by using a teaching method of his own.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E31 — Opie and the Carnival
Opie tries to win a birthday present for his father at a carnival shooting gallery without knowing that it is a scam.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S05 E32 — Banjo-Playing Deputy
A carnival's destitute banjo player is hired to take Barney's place.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S06 E01 — Opie's Job
Opie gets a part-time job in a grocery store but gives it up because another boy needs the job more.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S06 E02 — Andy's Rival
Andy is jealous when he realizes that a handsome teacher is spending evenings with Helen.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S06 E03 — Malcolm at the Crossroads
Andy hires a rock-throwing rustic as a school crossing guard.

title: The Andy Griffith Show
description:
S06 E04 — Aunt Bee, the Swinger
Aunt Bee and her new boyfriend discover that they aren't as young as they think.

title: God's Country Song
description: A charming but troubled country singer learns he has a 5-year-old son that he didn't know existed. Struggling with alcohol addiction, he must now decide whether to raise the boy or leave his family behind to pursue his dream of musical stardom.

description: Learning to Love

title: An Unlikely Angel
description: Businesswoman Janie is falling apart at the thought of becoming a mom, then has a chance meeting with an angel.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E24 — The Stranger
As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E25 — Escape to the Ponderosa
Adam is taken hostage by a band of U.S. Army prisoners who have escaped and sought refuge on the Ponderosa.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E26 — The Avenger
A wanderer seeking his parents' lynchers, arrives in Virginia City as Ben and Adam are convicted of murder.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E27 — The Last Trophy
Two British socialites find that they still have a lot to learn when they visit their friends, the Cartwrights.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E28 — San Francisco
Shortly after the Ponderosa cattle herd arrives in San Francisco at the hands of Hoss, Joe and Ben, two of their trail drivers are shanghaied and destined for Hong Kong.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E29 — Bitter Water
When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E30 — Feet of Clay
The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E31 — Dark Star
Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

title: Bonanza
description:
S01 E32 — Death at Dawn
A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E01 — Showdown
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E02 — The Mission
Hoss befriends Charlie Trent, a man who went from top Army scout to town drunk after he led his troops into a massacre.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E03 — Badge Without Honor
A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang; guest Dan Duryea.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E04 — The Mill
Ben tries to help his paraplegic neighbor Tom by setting up a grain mill on his unused land; Tom's hired hand raises his suspicion about Ben's plan.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E05 — The Hopefuls
Outlaws plot to steal a trunk containing the savings of a religious group heading for a new life in the West.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E06 — Denver McKee
The Cartwrights' neighbor (Franchot Tone), a former soldier and lawman, seeks security for his daughter.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E07 — Day of Reckoning
Bigoted Ike Daggett takes action when Ben gives an Indian and his wife land after the Indian saves his life.

title: Bonanza
description:
S02 E08 — The Abduction
Hoss and Little Joe spend the most unforgettable night at the carnival when Little Joe's date disappears.
